### Mobile dock had no playback speed control

**Where:** 390px loaded-trace screen, `#mobileTransport` after `body.trace-loaded-mobile.playback-ready`.

**Problem:** Desktop `#playbackBar` has 0.25×-4× speed presets. That bar is `display: none` below 720px, so the phone dock could Play / Pause but auto-advance stayed at 1×.

**Fix:** The dock keeps Step / Candidate / Play and Segment on the first two rows and adds the same five speed presets on a third row. Tapping a rate marks it active on both the dock and the desktop bar. Sidebar padding and the closed-panel Controls offset grew with the taller dock. The mobile Instructions table now names Speed.

**Evidence:**

- Mobile live playback-ready dock (390px): `web/usability/mobile-dock-speed-live.png`
- Mobile live Instructions (390px): `web/usability/mobile-dock-speed-instructions-live.png`
- Before/after markup fixture: `web/usability/mobile-dock-speed.html`
- Fixture screenshot: `web/usability/mobile-dock-speed.png`

A follow-up desktop and mobile pass after this change should confirm whether the taller speed row still clears Status / Instructions and whether any other unfriendliness remains.

content.text: {"success":true,"summary":"Added 0.25×-4× playback speed presets to the 390px dock and documented them with live and before/after screenshot evidence.","key_changes_made":["The mobile dock keeps Step / Candidate / Play and Segment on the first two rows and adds the same five speed presets on a third row, with active state synced to the desktop playback bar.","The playback-ready canvas is 38vh and dock clearance grew so Status, Instructions, and Controls stay above the taller bar; the mobile Instructions table now names Speed.","Captured 390px live dock and Instructions shots plus a before/after fixture, and logged that a later pass should watch Play on a real loaded trace."],"key_learnings":["A third dock row on the old 52vh canvas covers Status again; 38vh restores clearance even with the loaded params header.","Desktop and mobile both use .speed-preset, so the active class must follow data-speed or only the clicked viewport stays highlighted.","calc(100svh - 520px) collapsed the canvas to min-height 140px in this Chrome; a vh value matching the existing 52vh rule sized it correctly.","no-mistakes is still monitoring PR 7 and gnhf owns commits, so this iteration cannot open another PR."]}
